title: Gomi's MC +
description: A vanilla like modpack that adds vanilla like content.
body:
This **fabric** modpack aims to add **vanilla like** content and to **encourage exploration** to **basically re-explore Minecraft** that contains :

- **New biomes**

- **New mobs**

- **New dungeons**

- **Better generation**

- **Better UI**

- **Optimization** (Sodium etc...)

- **Other little modifications** (better crossair, better trees etc...)

- **And more !**

The _lite version_ remove a lot of content so it is a lot better to play the _full version_ of **Gomi's MC +**

**Make sure to download the right version between the lite and the full one**
